items.description: HTTP mount on / for selected reviews
vinted_reviews rows the admin picks as featured

blocks.text: Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-commerce-vinted-review/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. How long home-page reviews stay cached (for example 10m). Empty disables the cache and fetches every time.
